title: Understanding and Mitigating Political Stance Cross-topic Generalization in Large Language Models

bias_targets.methodology: Prompting LLMs to generate open-ended responses to political questions across various topics (such as crime, economy, gender, immigration, race, and science) using datasets like IDEOINST, The Political Compass, and IDRlabs Ideologies Test. An LLM evaluator (GPT-4o-mini) is then used to classify the generated responses as either left-leaning (-1) or right-leaning (+1) to quantify the model's ideological stance.
